sources.observation: Zoning certificate for specified outdoor-advertising construction/change actions; chapter maintenance/face-change exclusion includes electrical-component replacement but does not independently exempt electrical or building permits.

Distinct outdoor-advertising area/height/location, road-class spacing affidavits, buffers and cap-and-replace permit surrender provisions. General 660-foot restriction and I-75 replacement relocation within 300 feet require exception-hierarchy review. Variable-message prohibition requires separate litigation/current-legislation review, not automatic workflow denial.
Sandwich-board definition refers to temporary signs provided by the Village for adjacent-business sidewalk use; do not assume every customer-supplied A-frame qualifies.

Sidewalk-sign location requires approval; normal one-foot curb/building placement is not entitlement. Cafe-specific clearance/driveway/intersection provisions and broader review routing need applicability review; 36-inch baseline with discretion for more than five feet should not be silently normalized.
